modules.name: app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts#formatCitation
modules.why: The deep module this fix tightens. Given one Citation it returns one complete markdown list entry: '- ' marker, title/link (or the '(timestamp link unavailable)' label), '—' separator, 'M:SS–M:SS' range, and the '  > "<snippet>"' continuation line. It owns URL parsing, the fallback warning, and fallback selection internally, so callers never orchestrate. Today three fallback returns violate that contract; the fix makes every non-empty-snippet citation emit a marker-prefixed, snippet-carrying entry and collapses the two duplicated YouTube fallback exits (catch and !videoId, already byte-identical in both warn and return) into one 'if (!videoId)' branch — deletion, not growth. Signature and the empty-snippet guard are unchanged.

seams.name: app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts#formatCitation
seams.why: Unit seam for all four ACs: observable purely through its returned string (leading '- ', '(timestamp link unavailable)', '0:10–0:20', '> "<snippet>"' on its own line) with no DOM and no mocks beyond console.warn. Existing tests already exercise it this way; the new AC cases add only the assertions the buggy output lacks.

seams.name: app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts#formatSources
seams.why: Composition seam that distributes the symptom: it joins formatCitation entries with '\n' under '**Sources:**', so a marker-less entry merges into the previous list item when rendered. It stays unchanged — the contract forbids fixing the marker at the caller — and its existing tests pinning '- [Test Video]' entries keep passing.

public_interfaces.name: formatCitation(citation: Citation): string
public_interfaces.why: Signature unchanged. Output contract after the fix: every citation with a non-empty snippet returns exactly one '- '-prefixed entry whose snippet blockquote '  > "<snippet>"' sits on its own continuation line, matching the valid paths' shape; absent/empty/whitespace snippet still returns ''.

public_interfaces.name: formatSources(sources: Citation[]): string
public_interfaces.why: Unchanged. Every entry it receives is now a '- '-prefixed list item, so nothing merges when joined with '\n'.

public_interfaces.name: formatTimestamp(seconds: number): string
public_interfaces.why: Unchanged; out of scope, pinned by seven tests.

public_interfaces.name: exportConversationAsMarkdown(conversation: Conversation, messages: Message[]): void
public_interfaces.why: Unchanged; header, slug, filename, Blob and saveAs are all out of scope, pinned by eight tests.

public_interfaces.name: Citation (imported from ./api)
public_interfaces.why: Input type, unchanged: snippet: string; video_url: string; start_seconds/end_seconds: number; source_type?: 'youtube' | 'dynamous' | string; lesson_url?: string.

invariants.name: Envelope
invariants.why: app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts is the only production file edited; test edits stay in app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.test.ts; no new files.

invariants.name: Warn payload stays byte-identical
invariants.why: The merged single fallback branch warns exactly '[exportMarkdown] Skipping timestamp link — invalid video_url: "<video_url>"' (em dash U+2014) for both triggers — unparseable video_url and missing v param — so the existing assertions keep passing.

invariants.name: Unicode separators preserved
invariants.why: Em dash '—' (U+2014) between title/link and range; en dash '–' (U+2013) inside '0:10–0:20'. Template-literal whitespace is significant output, not style.

invariants.name: Empty-snippet guard untouched
invariants.why: The opening 'if (!citation.snippet?.trim()) return '';'' is unchanged, so absent/empty/whitespace snippets still yield ''.

invariants.name: Valid paths untouched
invariants.why: YouTube-with-v and Dynamous-with-lesson_url returns keep their exact current shape; only the three fallback returns change.

invariants.name: Marker and blockquote emitted inside formatCitation
invariants.why: Never patched at formatSources or exportConversationAsMarkdown; direct formatCitation consumers and the '\n' join both depend on entries being complete list items.

invariants.name: Dedup is deletion only
invariants.why: Merging the duplicated YouTube warn+return exits must remove code, not add branches; both triggers already produce byte-identical warnings and returns today, so behaviour is preserved and one warning site remains.

invariants.name: Red-first tests
invariants.why: New AC cases must fail on the unchanged tree by asserting the missing '- ' marker and/or the '> "<snippet>"' blockquote; every existing case keeps passing.

data_flows.name: Export render flow
data_flows.why: Message.sources (Citation[] delivered by the backend SSE 'sources' event and persisted on the message) → ChatArea export action → exportConversationAsMarkdown → formatSources → formatCitation per citation → entries joined with '\n' under '**Sources:**' → Blob → saveAs download. Only formatCitation's fallback outputs change.

data_flows.name: YouTube fallback flow (AC-1, AC-2, AC-4)
data_flows.why: new URL(video_url) throws, or searchParams.get('v') is empty → the single merged fallback branch → console.warn with the byte-identical payload, then return '- ${title} (timestamp link unavailable) — ${range}' + '\n  > "${snippet}"'.

data_flows.name: Dynamous fallback flow (AC-3)
data_flows.why: lesson_url missing or whitespace-only after the existing trim → return '- ${title} — ${range}' + '\n  > "${snippet}"' (marker added; no '](' since there is no URL).

data_flows.name: Valid flows (frozen)
data_flows.why: YouTube with v: '- [${title}](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${v}&t=${floor(start)}s) — ${range}' + '\n  > "${snippet}"'. Dynamous with lesson_url: '- [${title}](${lesson_url}) — ${range}' + '\n  > "${snippet}"'.
